notes: NAME LIKELY CORRECTED (research 2026-07-03): the compiled PEI Morrow family register (islandregister.com/morrow1.html) names Eunice Coffin's husband as 'John (Jr.) Morrow,' married ca. 1785 — not 'William John Morrow (Morrogh).' 'William' appears to be a conflation with their youngest son, William Morrow (b. ca. 1805). The couple had (at least) eight recorded children per that source: Abigail, Elisha, John III, James, Andrew, Thomas, Benjamin, and William — more than the three currently listed here.

DEATH PLACE & MOTHER OPEN QUESTIONS (research 2026-07-03): a separate check of the same islandregister.com "Descendants of John Morrow" register (which treated this as one confirmed match rather than flagging the name issue above) noted two further discrepancies: it gives his death place as "Surveyors Inlet, PEI" rather than this tree's "North Lake, Kings, PEI" (both are in the same East Point/Kings County area, so this may just be two names for the same homestead); and it does not name his mother "Mary Twaddle" as this tree does, listing only an unnamed "Female Morrow (b. c.1735, d. 25 Jan 1815)." Whether "Mary Twaddle" comes from another source or is unsupported remains unresolved.
